name: wasm-calculator
description: A quote machine whose pricing and option-availability logic runs in WebAssembly (compiled from AssemblyScript).

scripts.asbuild: npm run asbuild:debug && npm run asbuild:release
scripts.build: npm run validate:model && npm run asbuild:release && npm run build:site
scripts.test: node --test test/split-merge.test.mjs test/expr.test.mjs test/rule.test.mjs test/binding.test.mjs test/schema-conformance.test.mjs test/editor-engine.test.mjs test/coverage.test.mjs test/ref-eval.test.mjs test/vm-parity.test.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy dist

author: rossjdharrison
